title: Debug: sre_package_management APIConnectionError in nested LangGraph
description:
sre_package_management ALWAYS fails with 'Server disconnected without sending a response' when invoked via ops_manager task tool, but ALWAYS succeeds when run standalone.

KEY FINDINGS (2026-04-29):
- State passed to subagent is clean: only 'messages' key, no extra state (non_msg={})
- Description sizes 1896-2987 chars, request body ~30-32KB - NOT a size issue
- Standalone sre_package_management: ALL sizes succeed
- Full pipeline (ops_manager → task → sre_package_management): ALWAYS fails
- 3/3 sequential runs in same asyncio.run() all fail
- The initial standalone test that succeeded was because it ran in a FRESH asyncio.run() each time

HYPOTHESIS: The nested LangGraph execution (ops_manager running, then invoking subagent via task tool inside asyncio.create_task) causes httpx async transport issue. The subagent's ChatOpenAI httpx client fails on its VERY FIRST request when the event loop is already busy with ops_manager's LangGraph execution.

THINGS RULED OUT:
- State size (non_msg={})
- Request body size (~30KB is fine)
- Description length (all sizes fail in pipeline, all sizes work standalone)
- max_retries setting (even with max_retries=1, both the original and retry fail)

NEXT STEPS TO TRY:
1. Pass http_client=httpx.AsyncClient(limits=httpx.Limits(max_keepalive_connections=0)) to ChatOpenAI in _make_maas_model() to disable keepalive
2. Check if openai.AsyncOpenAI shares connection pool across instances (module-level pool?)
3. Try creating the subagent model INSIDE atask rather than at setup time
4. Wrap subagent.ainvoke in asyncio.shield() to isolate async context
5. Check if there is something about the httpx transport binding to event loop

DIAGNOSTIC PATCH APPLIED TO POD user-c8zp8-agentic/athena-747669d44b-2fcvn:
- /app/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/deepagents/middleware/subagents.py patched with diagnostic logging at atask() (stderr output, no functional change)

WORKAROUND AVAILABLE:
- Route python3.14 failures to sre_ansible/sre_linux (revert commit f0f55da changes to AGENTS.md) - confirmed to work for user-7pnfr
- This is the original behavior before sre_package_management was added to AGENTS.md Domain Awareness
close_reason: Fixed: streaming=True on ChatOpenAI prevents MaaS Route 30s timeout. Root cause was large subagent context (60KB+) causing slow LLM response that exceeded HAProxy default timeout.

title: Add retry logic to AAP2 client HTTP calls
description: Athena's AAP2 adapter (athena/adapters/aap2.py) makes httpx calls to the controller API without retry logic. When AAP2 drops the connection mid-request (RemoteProtocolError: Server disconnected without sending a response), the pipeline fails with a traceback instead of retrying.\n\nAdd tenacity or manual retry with backoff to get_job(), get_job_stdout(), get_job_events(), and register_webhook() methods. Transient HTTP errors (502, 503, connection reset) should retry 3 times with exponential backoff.
